description: This file contains test cases for the 'RemotionTemplate' in a project, using pytest framework. It includes fixtures for creating temporary directories and mock template files, as well as various tests verifying template initialization, project setup, script execution, configuration loading, and variable replacement functionality.

methods.name: temp_dir()
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for test outputs using tempfile.mkdtemp(). Cleans up after test.

methods.name: template_dir(temp_dir)
methods.description: Sets up a mock template directory with configuration files and sample source files for testing template processing.

methods.name: project_config(temp_dir)
methods.description: Creates a sample ProjectConfig object for use in tests, representing a Remotion project.

methods.name: test_remotion_init_info(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Verifies that the template provides correct initialization information, specifically checking commands like 'npm install'.

methods.name: test_project_initialization(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Tests complete project initialization, verifying output directory and file content replacements.

methods.name: test_post_processing_execution(template_dir, project_config, temp_dir)
methods.description: Checks that post-processing scripts are executed correctly, e.g., creating a marker file to confirm execution.

methods.name: test_config_file_loading(temp_dir)
methods.description: Tests loading project configuration from a JSON file and verifying correct parsing.

methods.name: test_template_variable_replacement(template_dir, project_config)
methods.description: Ensures template variable placeholders are correctly replaced with project configuration values in output files.
